body:
## Pensieve 0.6.8

### New
- **Experience library.** Keep what worked and what cost you — with your advisor, with people, in everyday life — typed or told by voice; the AI writes down the lesson. Before you act, ask it ("my advisor wants this by Monday — what do I say?") and it answers from your own experiences and shows which ones.
- **Money.** Record spending and income in one line ("午饭 35"), by voice, or from a WeChat Pay or Alipay screenshot. A monthly budget, where the money went, day by day, the whole year, an AI look at your spending — the same on your phone and computer.
- **Lists and colours in pages, as in Notion.** Drag list items by their ⋮⋮ handle (the numbers follow); numbering 1. a. i. by level or your choice (A. I. 一、 (1) ①), bullets ● ○ ■ – ◆ ➤; text colours and marker highlights in nine colours.

Update Pensieve on every device: an older version shows coloured text as a plain highlight.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.8.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.8-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.8-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.8-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.8-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.8-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.8-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
